scope: Read-only postrun review. No training, model replay, changed gates, or alteration of scientific verdict.
evidence_level: No demonstrated retained four-operation E3 for new candidates. Taught association is impaired in the low-sample regime.
confirmed_findings: Current byte expansion replaced the earlier specialist scalar additive learner; it did not preserve that model and only change serialization.
New candidates selected immediate EOS on 46.5–54.7% of final held-out probes, compared with 1.03% for LEGACY-B.
At 16 and 32 samples per operation, new candidates had zero taught accuracy and all taught probes returned an empty reply. At 64, BYTE candidates remained there and VALUE candidates barely recovered.
Final taught macro accuracy is 66.9–69.2% for new candidates and 99.72% for LEGACY-B.
Numerical auxiliary learning lowered held-out MAE from 10.64 to 6.42 in ADD and from 10.19 to 6.15 in PROD, but did not produce exact arithmetic byte answers.
The final technical world already had 0% held-out accuracy for all four candidates and only 66.5–72.7% pooled taught accuracy.
The shared-only qualification fixture used 1024 records across only five fixed contexts: about 205 repeats per context. That established eventual memorization, not the required sample efficiency.
PROD multiplies two learned projections of the entire prompt. Neither projection is an identified operand value or role.
Scientific tasks are single binary operations interleaved in a history; mixed expressions with precedence and parentheses were not tested.

source_grounded_inference.hypothesis: A frequent unconditional EOS preference in the newly shared categorical learner overtakes conditional byte predictions and the fixed 0.25 memory contribution before useful prompt/position discrimination develops.
source_grounded_inference.support: EOS is about 45.1% of all observed reply events; the code has a learned global categorical bias, independent shared CE, and fixed uncalibrated logit mixing. Output trajectories show immediate termination through the middle budgets.
source_grounded_inference.not_proved: No per-probe branch logits or final scientific parameter checkpoints were retained, so branch dominance cannot be causally quantified from these receipts alone.

review_failure: Technical validity was reported as readiness without surfacing the already-observed learning collapse. The formal design did not have a scientific E1 feasibility gate, so this is a preparation/design weakness, not a retroactive invalidation of the recorded run.
mechanism_scope: Reject the tested recipes within their budget; do not globally eliminate numerical supervision, feature interaction, arbitrary byte I/O, or other inventory families.
next_design_principle: Keep unseen four-operation exact own byte output per sample/compute as primary. Preserve a numerical/relational learning path across interface changes, represent operand roles and operation-conditioned relationships explicitly or with a learnable decomposition, and qualify the actual low-sample training/decoder regime before formal confirmation. Do not replace E3 with taught recall or numerical MAE.
